tool_schemas.name: get_price
tool_schemas.description: Returns the latest cached market price snapshot for the resolved instrument identified by `ticker` for the requested `period` (default `1d`), refreshing from the upstream provider when the cache is missing or stale. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `ticker` is empty/invalid or `period` is unsupported, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to access the service, NOT_FOUND if the ticker cannot be resolved to a tracked instrument, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if your API-usage limits would be exceeded by the required upstream refresh.

tool_schemas.name: get_news
tool_schemas.description: Returns up to `count` cached, normalized news articles associated with the resolved instrument identified by `ticker` (default `count=5`), refreshing from the upstream provider when the cache is missing or stale; results are limited to the requested count (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `ticker` is empty/invalid or `count` is not a positive integer within allowed limits, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to access the service, NOT_FOUND if the ticker cannot be resolved to a tracked instrument, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if your API-usage limits would be exceeded by the required upstream refresh.

tool_schemas.name: get_me
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity and entitlements, including active scopes and current rate-limit/quota consumption. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the provided API key is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the client is not permitted, and returns the caller’s status (active/suspended/revoked) to explain refusals.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate the request.

tool_schemas.name: list_instruments
tool_schemas.description: Lists tracked instruments with optional filters and pagination, ordered by most recently updated. Returns only instruments visible to the caller. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to access the service.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate the request.

symbol.description: Filter by instrument symbol (case-insensitive exact match).

exchange.description: Filter by exchange code (e.g., NASDAQ, NYSE).

provider.description: Filter by upstream data provider identifier.

limit.description: Maximum number of instruments to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_instrument
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single instrument by id. Raises NOT_FOUND if the instrument does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to access the service.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate the request.

tool_schemas.name: create_instrument
tool_schemas.description: Creates a tracked instrument record. Enforces uniqueness on (symbol, exchange, asset_type); if a conflicting instrument exists the request is refused with CONFLICT. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid fields and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to access the service.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate the request.

symbol.description: Instrument symbol/ticker (stored normalized; comparisons are case-insensitive).

exchange.description: Exchange code (required for stocks/etfs/indexes; may be omitted for some crypto/forex providers).

provider.description: Upstream provider identifier that resolved this instrument.

tool_schemas.name: update_instrument
tool_schemas.description: Updates an instrument by id, including lifecycle transitions via `status`. Refuses invalid transitions (e.g., delisted cannot change) with CONFLICT. Enforces uniqueness on (symbol, exchange, asset_type) when those fields change. Raises NOT_FOUND if the instrument does not exist and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to access the service.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate the request.

status.description: New lifecycle status (must be a valid transition).

tool_schemas.name: list_request_logs
tool_schemas.description: Lists request log entries for the authenticated client with optional filters and pagination, ordered by newest first. Returns only logs belonging to the caller. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to access the service.

api_key.description: Client API key used to authenticate the request.

from_created_at.description: Filter logs created at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

to_created_at.description: Filter logs created at or before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of log rows to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

metadata.name: Finance MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend stores tracked financial instruments (stocks/crypto), cached market price snapshots by period, and cached news articles tied to each instrument. The main workflows are: resolve a requested ticker to an instrument, fetch/refresh price and news from upstream providers, persist normalized
